description: This file contains a Swift implementation of a JPEG transcoder, providing functionality for decoding, processing, and re-encoding JPEG images with size and quality constraints. It includes error handling, metadata extraction, thumbnail generation, and size optimization strategies.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A utility struct that provides methods to transcode JPEG images by resizing and adjusting quality while adhering to size constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps the quality value between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main method that re-encodes image data to JPEG format with optional resizing to a maximum width and size constraints.
